name: Delicate Tomb

frame.name: Traitor's Vessel
frame.description:
Fires a wide horizontal spread when shot from the hip.
Final blows with this weapon have a chance to generate Ionic Traces. Powerful foes and opposing Guardians always generate Ionic Traces.

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.description:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Tempest Cascade
perks.description: Collecting an Ionic Trace overcharges this weapon's next shot, jolting targets on hit.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: The danger within is repulsive to us.

catalyst.name: Delicate Tomb Catalyst
catalyst.description: Collecting an Ionic Trace partially reloads the magazine from reserves.
